Fixes HackHack AI - OR-115

- Document simple mode with `anchor-asm-v2` as a build dependency and `anchor-asm-v2-runtime` as the program dependency. 
- Remove `include_asm!` from `anchor-asm-v2`. The macro stays on the zero-dependency runtime crate.
- Correct the runtime crate's own example including `#![no_std]`.
